title.rendered: Arqaam Capital was thrilled to host a high-impact panel at the annual Arqaam Capital Conference in Abu Dhabi

content.rendered:
Arqaam Capital was thrilled to host a high-impact panel last Monday at the annual Arqaam Capital Conference in Abu Dhabi, bringing critical market intelligence to the forefront as part of our ongoing commitment to thought leadership. 

 

The discussion, led by Arqaam’s own experts, explored the powerful forces shaping GCC finance – from its $1 Trillion+ scale and explosive growth to the unstoppable momentum of the Global Sukuk Market ($1.3T+ and racing!) and the strategic shifts defining investment and risk.

 

We are immensely proud of our team for sharing their deep, on-the-ground expertise and leading this vital conversation:

 

Mehdi POPOTTW, CFA:  Our moderator, who expertly steered the discussion with insight and energy.

Fady Gendy, CFA: Representing our Fixed Income Asset Management, delivering profound and valuable insights on GCC credit’s unique standing.
 

Jad Raouda, MBA: From our Sales & Trading desk, capturing the live pulse of investor appetite.

 

Omar Musharraf: Our DCM expert, providing the crucial issuer perspective on funding strategies.

 

A huge and special thank you to our distinguished guest, Dr. Mohamed Damak, Global Head of Islamic Finance at S&P Global Ratings. Your participation and invaluable global context, especially on the transformative future of Sukuk, significantly enriched our discussion.  

Bringing together Arqaam Capital’s leading talent with respected external voices exemplifies our dedication to delivering unparalleled market insights for our clients and the wider financial community.
